scope: Completed native 2D scalar-index optical surrogate and 1D prescribed-charge Poisson diagnostics. No experimental authentication or full-device physical qualification.
power_definition: abs(S[output, source])^2, incident guided mode normalized to one; diagnostics maxima span each case grid and all sources.
phase_scope: Cross-run phase basis is not aligned; no coherent passivity or phase-convergence claim.

ring_bias_comparison.estimate_limits: Sub-grid three-point parabolic peak estimates on a 0.1 nm grid; no uncertainty or mesh-converged electro-optic shift is established. Carrier index and absolute absorption both change.

spectral_resolution_control.limits: Spectral-resolution control only; no mesh/domain/model uncertainty bound or physical SOI calibration.
